parameters.query: SELECT id, name, node_id, telegram_id FROM panelists WHERE telegram_id = '{{ $json.telegram_id }}' LIMIT 1

SELECT apd.id, apd.tag_id, apd.status, apd.fecha_programada, apd.destination_panelist_name, apd.origin_node_id, n.auto_id as origin_node_auto_id 
FROM allocation_plan_details apd 
LEFT JOIN nodes n ON n.id = apd.origin_node_id 
WHERE apd.tag_id = '{{ $json.tag_id }}' 
AND apd.destination_node_id = '{{ $json.node_id }}'
AND apd.status = 'sent' 
ORDER BY apd.fecha_programada ASC 
LIMIT 1

UPDATE allocation_plan_details 
SET 
  status = 'received', 
  received_at = NOW(),
  destination_panelist_id = (SELECT id FROM panelists WHERE node_id = '{{ $('Set IDs').item.json.node_id }}' LIMIT 1),
  origin_panelist_id = (SELECT id FROM panelists WHERE node_id = '{{ $('Check tag in allocation plan').first().json.origin_node_id }}' LIMIT 1)
WHERE id = '{{ $('Check tag in allocation plan').first().json.id }}'
RETURNING id, tag_id, status, destination_panelist_name, origin_node_id

SELECT 
  apd.id, 
  apd.fecha_programada,
  apd.destination_node_id,
  COALESCE(dest_p.name, apd.destination_panelist_name, 'Desconocido') as destination_panelist_name,
  c.name as carrier, 
  prod.description as product,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY apd.fecha_programada ASC) as parcel_number 
FROM allocation_plan_details apd
LEFT JOIN allocation_plans ap ON ap.id = apd.plan_id
LEFT JOIN carriers c ON c.id = ap.carrier_id
LEFT JOIN products prod ON prod.id = ap.product_id
LEFT JOIN panelists dest_p ON dest_p.node_id = apd.destination_node_id
WHERE apd.origin_node_id = '{{ $json.node_id }}' 
  AND apd.status IN ('pending', 'notified') 
  AND (apd.tag_id IS NULL OR apd.tag_id = '') 
ORDER BY apd.fecha_programada ASC 
LIMIT 10

-- Delete any existing pending_tag context for this user
DELETE FROM public.panelist_context 
WHERE telegram_id = '{{ $('Set IDs').first().json.telegram_id }}'
  AND context_type = 'pending_tag';

-- Insert new pending_tag context with the tag_id and pending parcels list
INSERT INTO public.panelist_context (telegram_id, context_type, context_data)
VALUES (
    '{{ $('Set IDs').first().json.telegram_id }}',
    'pending_tag',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'tag_id', '{{ $('Set IDs').first().json.tag_id }}',
        'pending_parcels', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.parcels) }}'::jsonb
    )
);

SELECT 
    '{{ $json.response }}' as response,
    'assign_list' as action;

assignments.name: response
